Everywhere All at Once]]'' led the film nominations with 14—a then-record shared with ''[[The Shape of Water]]'' ([[23rd Critics' Choice Awards|2017]]), ''[[The Favourite (2018 film)|The Favourite]]'' ([[24th Critics' Choice Awards|2018]]), and ''[[The Irishman]]'' ([[25th Critics' Choice Awards|2019]])—followed by ''[[The Fabelmans]]'' with 11. [[American Broadcasting Company|ABC]]'s first-year [[mockumentary]] comedy ''[[Abbott Elementary]]'' led the television nominations with six, followed by ''[[Better Call Saul]]''{{'}}s [[Better Call Saul (season 6)|sixth and final season]] with five.
